    global index
    value = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    return value

    value = list(map(int, data[index:index + read_int()]))
    index += read_int()
    return value

n = read_int()

    while queue:

            if not visited[neighbor]:
                visited[neighbor] = True
                distance[neighbor] = distance[node] + 1
